meta.title: Pricing — from 3 € per vehicle per month
meta.description: PTS pricing per vehicle per month: Solo 3 € (time tracking or route planning), Kombi 5 € (both). Month-to-month, 14-day free trial, no setup fee.

hero.h1: One price per vehicle. Everything included.
hero.sub: No setup, no user fee, no add-on modules. 14-day free trial, then month-to-month.

note: All prices per vehicle per month, excl. VAT. 15 % discount on annual commitment.

items.q: Do I pay per vehicle or per driver?
items.a: Per vehicle. A vehicle can be used by any number of drivers — the number of users is not limited.
No. Onboarding including data migration and training is included in both tiers.
Month-to-month. Annual commitment gets a 15 % discount and you can switch back to monthly at any time.
Nothing automatically. You'll receive a quote by email. If you don't sign, your data expires and gets deleted after 30 days.
